Name: Tifa Lockhart - Emily replacer
Author: Jolamods
Description:
[b]English[/b]
Replace Emily with Tifa-inspired portraits and sprites, including winter clothing, bikini beach variants, dance and wedding poses. Portraits, sprites and variants can be toggled separately. Emily's name, dialogue and events remain unchanged.

[b]Install:[/b] Requires [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.9.0+. Extract the mod into Mods and launch with SMAPI. Edit config.json with the game closed. Tested texture loading on Stardew Valley 1.6.15; complete events and mod combinations remain untested.

[b]1.0.2:[/b] Fixed walking-eye flicker across all outfits. Includes corrected smiles, meditation hands and clean frame edges.

[b]Credits / AI:[/b] Tifa: Square Enix. Stardew Valley: ConcernedApe. SMAPI/CP: Pathoschild and contributors. Reference supplied by the user; original author and rights unverified. Art generated with OpenAI; assembly assisted by Codex. Unofficial fan mod. Cover is promotional art, not gameplay. Nexus tags: AI-Generated Content, AI Media.

Which anime character or villager replacement would you like next? Comment your ideas!

[b]简体中文[/b]
用蒂法风格的头像与行走图替换艾米丽，包含冬装、比基尼海滩外观、舞蹈及婚礼姿势。头像、行走图与外观可分别开关；姓名、对话和事件保持原样。

[b]安装：[/b]需要 [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 与 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.9.0+。解压至 Mods，通过 SMAPI 启动。关闭游戏后编辑 config.json。已验证游戏 1.6.15 的贴图加载；完整事件与模组组合尚未测试。

[b]1.0.2：[/b]修正所有服装的行走眼睛闪动，并包含微笑、冥想手部与格子边缘修正。

[b]致谢／AI：[/b]蒂法：Square Enix；Stardew Valley：ConcernedApe；SMAPI/CP：Pathoschild 及贡献者。参考图由用户提供，原作者与权限未确认。美术由 OpenAI 生成，组装使用 Codex 协助。非官方同人模组。封面为宣传插画，非实机截图。Nexus 标签：AI-Generated Content、AI Media。
